function.name: create_file_from_block
function.description: Create a new file from provided content block

file_name.description: Path to the new file (legacy alias)

function.name: eval
function.description: Execute Python with IPython or JavaScript in a persistent, session-local kernel in the project workspace. Bindings survive cells and turns while the engine session remains live. Top-level await is supported. Shell tools share the workspace but not kernel variables. Engine restart loses kernel state. A timeout or cancellation may reset the selected kernel; inspect the result. This tool does not provide the native OMP tool, agent, or workpool prelude.

language.description: Kernel language, py for IPython or js for JavaScript

code.description: Code to execute in the selected persistent kernel

timeout.description: Cell deadline in seconds; defaults to 30, and 0 disables the deadline

reset.description: Clear only the selected language's state before executing this cell

function.name: list_dir
function.description: List files in a directory; supports optional depth for tree view

function.name: mark_task_complete
function.description: Signal that the task is fully complete and end the session

function.name: read_file
function.description: Read a file's content with optional offset/limit for large files

function.name: run_shell
function.description: Execute a shell command in the project workspace
